frameStorage: Original screenshot containers preserved byte for byte and deduplicated by encoded-byte SHA-256. Actual formats determine extensions; source filenames remain in capture provenance. No additional lossy conversion.

canonicalPixelDecoder.name: FFmpeg
canonicalPixelDecoder.version: ffmpeg version 8.0 Copyright (c) 2000-2025 the FFmpeg developers
canonicalPixelDecoder.scope: Canonical RGBA hashes use this FFmpeg build. JPEG chroma/RGB rounding can differ across decoders or builds; original encoded-byte hashes remain authoritative.

runtimeDependencies: FFmpeg/ffprobe with JPEG/PNG/WebP decoding and libx264
reproducibilityBoundary: Complete static inputs with exact original screenshot-container bytes, chronology, editorial timing and report data. Canonical RGBA hashes are scoped to the recorded FFmpeg build; decoded JPEG pixels can differ with other decoders. Final MP4 bytes and system-font rendering may vary with external runtime versions. No new AWS/local adapter execution occurs during rendering.
